meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当你要求把技术内容讲成大白话时,Claude 会按 who(谁)、what(什么)、where(哪里)、why(为什么)、when(何时)五个角度给出拆解说明。
howto.when: 当你说某内容太技术、想用大白话了解它的人、事、地点、原因和时间时,它会接管解释。

say.note: 按这五个角度给出通俗说明

say.text: 这段技术说明太绕,用人话讲讲它是什么
say.note: 把技术表述换成大白话

say.text: 用普通人能听懂的话解释这个技术概念
say.note: 给出面向非技术读者的解释

howto.what_en: When you ask for a plain-English breakdown of something technical, Claude explains the who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say something sounds too technical and ask for a plain-English breakdown covering who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: Break down this technical thing in plain English: who, what, where, why, when
This is too technical — explain it to me in plain English
say_en.note: Turns the technical wording into plain English

say_en.text: Explain this tech concept so a non-expert can follow
say_en.note: Keeps the explanation plain and simple
